Specializing in the modern .NET ecosystem **(my.NET 9/10, MAUI, Blazor)**, I bridge the gap between complex backend architecture and engaging frontend experiences. A **polyglot developer (C#, Python, Kotlin) and AI-adopter** who leverages cutting-edge tools to accelerate delivery. Proven track record in engineering robust **Microservices**, developing **algorithmic trading bots**, and integrating **Blockchain technology**. I turn abstract business concepts into deployed, **production-ready reality.**

work.position: Senior .NET contractor and remote technical consultant (Part-time / Remote Technical Contractor)
work.name: Ayar Plus
work.summary: * Part-time remote technical contractor alongside the full-time Pazhoohan role. Custom accounting software for the Kuwait market; employer Iranian, based in Kuwait. .NET MAUI frontend: XAML, multilingual UI, gold ERP (inventory, gold math, gold accounting) on .NET 10 integrated with a PHP backend. * Online and offline invoicing; Windows client discovered the Android client on the LAN and queued requests until the app was online. * App on Google Play; CI/CD published Android and iOS to Google Play and the App Store so customers were not disrupted. * Card readers in Kuwait gold shops for Civil ID scans; card photos stored on ImageKit and used in the Android app. * For a stretch also project coordination: remote weekly sprints, daily and weekly meetings; MAUI colleague in Mashhad, backend in Qom, bridge to the Product Owner. * Started a full cross-platform rewrite on Bit Platform with migration of old data; packages for PDF and printing receipts and invoices.

work.name: Ertebatat Pazhoohan Matin
work.summary: * Full-time role after BahamShop. Enterprise school-transport platform for municipalities (Shiraz, Isfahan, Qazvin) on C# and Onion Architecture. Features, reports, query work, speed. * Some cities had more than 200,000 users; accounting and the payment gateway sat on the same platform among fleets, services, drivers, students, and parents, including an inspector role. * At the start designed Safir Mehr, a native Kotlin Android fleet app for customers. * ALPR for inspectors with Python and FastAPI: photo in, plate text out, check against the company fleet. * Much of the work in Cursor: rules and skills on the models, code review, fast MVPs. One MVP was a Snapp-like trip app on .NET 10, PostgreSQL Polygon, SignalR, and Redis (request, driver accept/reject, dashboard, fleet in admin). * Contract term ended Jul 2026. Overlapping part-time remote contractor role at Ayar Plus from Sep 2025 through Sep 2026.

work.position: Project manager; SEO lead and Figma designer
work.name: BahamShop (Product Search Engine Startup)
work.summary: * Product search engine with a scraper and SEO for click revenue. Site had no revenue until I joined; it reached income in the first month. * Roles: SEO team lead, Figma designer, project manager. * n8n automation prepared SEO content per product tag and category; the SEO team edited and inserted it, which raised product indexing speed. * Backend on ASP.NET Core 9 with Clean Architecture and caching for faster responses. * Tenure closed Jun 2025; moved to the next role.

work.position: Independent engineer; trading systems, automation, and architecture R&D
work.name: Independent
work.summary: * Shifted focus to trading systems, automation, and architecture research. Wrote MQL4 and MQL5 trading bots with module backtesting, budget management, trading mindset, and capital management. * Practiced Blazor Hybrid and the .NET MAUI path for cross-platform clients. * Built a few .NET samples that implemented a smart contract inside a .NET project. * Deepened Git, Agile/Scrum, and DevOps; learned Docker. * Raised architecture fluency including Onion Architecture and older styles. * Used Python on trading systems; practiced Pine Script. * Part-time consulting through Dec 2024: e-commerce sites and n8n automation pipelines.

work.position: Electricity-distribution automation support and development; microservices rewrite
work.name: ParsiaAfzar FaraAndishanNovin
work.summary: * Supported and developed an existing MVC electricity-distribution automation system (Bushehr, Mazandaran, Greater Tehran, Arak, and other cities) via tickets, development, and bug fixes. * Proposed and implemented a unified rewrite with Microservices, CQRS, RabbitMQ, DDD, Vue.js, monitoring, and .NET Core. * Built a custom ASP.NET Core MVC CMS for the company site. * In Jan 2023 shifted focus to trading systems and independent research.

work.name: Rasta International Finance
work.summary: * First real use of Git and DevOps; with the then project manager, moved the company from informal process onto Agile/Scrum and DevOps. * Worked on the CRM (including Angular) and networked investment platforms; salon reservation projects in the same company. * Late in the tenure, took over project follow-up after the then project manager left.

work.name: Nikan Exir Vista Rayan
work.summary: * Backend .NET developer: designed and implemented ASP.NET Core REST APIs for a queue-management system and worked with the team's new PWA. * Learned SQL Server on the job against real data. * First production .NET role after two years of military service; company focus was accounting software.
